question: The user presses Ctrl+C while the model's edit is pending. What must the next request contain?

options.text: A guard line with its limit and value, then run_end with the guard's status.
options.why: Right. The guard is traced first, so the run can be read after it ends.

options.text: Only run_end: the guard is not traced.
options.why: Tempting and wrong. Each guard writes its guard line before the run ends.

options.text: A model_error line, because the model ran out of room.
options.why: Tempting and wrong. model_error is for failed calls; a guard is not a failure of the model.

options.text: It removes the call from the history.
options.why: Tempting and wrong. The history keeps every request; each one still needs its result.

options.why: Right. close_open_calls() answers each pending request before the run ends.
